main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The science and spirituality behind the millennium
header_desc: The Gnostic Gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion of the psyche; to counter it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless —the ONE—, which manifests through the pneuma. This reveals to us that we possess a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩, so what is referred to as the <q>rapture of the church</q> is nothing more than a spiritual awakening.
left_title: From the material psyche 🧠 ┻ to the divine pneuma ❤️ ✝️
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego has mass and exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion ┻ of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the divine wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the statement «the Father and I are one» is a call to dissolve the «false self» to return to the Pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, the timeless and divine reality ✝️ of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of unity and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ (represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️) and the material |EGO⟩ (represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠).
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and framework for integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton’s and Maxwell’s laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breaking of simultaneity by Einstein, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Spacetime { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The finding at Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as the confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— there resounds the phrase of Jesus more strongly: «The Father and I are one». Could this have a hidden message about the profound bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfactory... it makes little sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
